scripts.check: corepack pnpm --dir frontend check && corepack pnpm --dir desktop check
scripts.backend:check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "& (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff format --check backend; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff check backend; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m pyright --project backend"
scripts.backend:format: powershell -NoProfile -Command "& (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff format backend; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff check --fix backend"
